facts.statement: Tenant Freya Palmer reported overgrown tree and weeds at Flat 17, 67 Willowmere Road, Alderwick, ZZ7 4ZZ on 16 Dec 2025; classified routine, no safety risk described.
At intake the tenant answered that the overgrowth is in a 'communal area', contradicting the classifier's assumption of a private garden.
Riverside Services were instructed on 17 Dec 2025 and told to quote and not proceed without agency approval; reminders were sent 18, 20 and 23 Dec.
No message from the contractor exists anywhere in the visible history; on 25 Dec the agency recorded that 3+ reminders had gone unanswered.

On 3 Jan 2026 the agency told the landlord the garden maintenance 'has been done now and will be invoiced off the rent'; no amount, VAT, provider report or photos are on record and the invoice logged on 6 Jan is unavailable.
The only landlord message is a courtesy reply with no reference to cost or completion; it carries the footer 'Sent from Oakfield Utilities'.
No landlord spend cap or standing instruction is on file; 'Landlord approval confirmed' is a system status line, not a landlord message.

options: Verify with Riverside Services and the tenant that the work was done, obtain the invoice and photos, forward the invoice to the landlord with the amount, then close naming who paid.
